nodes.label: JavaScript Event Delegation Pattern
nodes.rationale: Event delegation prevents duplicate event listeners and provides fallback systems so buttons keep working across both static and dynamically loaded content.

nodes.label: Processing Locks (order_process lock key)
nodes.rationale: A per-user lock key with a 30-second expiry ensures a user can only process one order at a time, preventing concurrent duplicate processing while avoiding indefinite deadlocks.

nodes.label: File Organization
nodes.rationale: Deliverables (Google Sheets/Slides/cloud outputs) are kept separate from intermediates (local processing files) so the user always accesses results through cloud services, while local files remain disposable and regeneratable.

nodes.label: Operating Principles
nodes.rationale: Three principles keep the agent reliable: check execution/ for existing tools before writing new scripts; self-anneal by fixing and testing broken scripts (checking with the user first if paid tokens/credits are involved) and recording what was learned; and treat directives as living documents updated (never overwritten without asking) as constraints and better approaches are discovered.

nodes.label: Self-Annealing Loop
nodes.rationale: Errors are treated as learning opportunities: fix the issue, update the tool, test it, update the directive to include the new flow -- so the system gets stronger over time rather than repeating the same failure.

nodes.label: Laravel Valet Method
nodes.rationale: For developers with Composer, Valet's 'secure' command automatically provisions HTTPS for a local site as a faster alternative to manual Apache SSL configuration.

nodes.label: mkcert Method
nodes.rationale: Presented as an easier alternative to manual OpenSSL certificate generation: mkcert installs a locally-trusted CA and issues a localhost certificate without browser security warnings.

nodes.label: XAMPP Built-in SSL Setup Method
nodes.rationale: Recommended method: enable mod_ssl in XAMPP's httpd-ssl.conf and install a certificate so localhost can serve HTTPS, which is required for PWA install, service workers, and push notifications to work.

nodes.label: Optimistic Locking (Version Control)
nodes.rationale: A version column prevents lost updates when multiple processes modify the same product record concurrently.

nodes.label: Row-Level Locking (FOR UPDATE)
nodes.rationale: Products are locked with FOR UPDATE during stock validation so concurrent transactions cannot read and modify the same stock row simultaneously, preventing overselling.

nodes.label: 3-Layer Architecture
nodes.rationale: LLMs are probabilistic while business logic is deterministic and requires consistency, so separating concerns maximizes reliability. If the agent does everything itself, errors compound (90% accuracy per step = 59% success over 5 steps); pushing complexity into deterministic code lets the agent focus purely on decision-making.

nodes.label: Order Hash Duplicate Prevention
nodes.rationale: Each order gets a unique hash from user id, cart contents, and timestamp so duplicate orders from repeated 'Buy' clicks are rejected via the orders.order_hash unique key.
